Built for your kind of business

Pharmacy POS system

A dedicated pharmacy platform: medicines by batch and expiry date (FEFO), expired stock blocked from sale, prescriptions for prescription-only medicines, dosage labels on receipts and a controlled drugs register.

Butchery POS system

Sell meat by weight (kg) or by amount ("nipe ya elfu tano"), update prices per kg on a daily price board, cut a carcass into stock with the real cost per kg, and track waste.

Shop & supermarket POS

Fast barcode checkout for minimarts, supermarkets, wholesale, hardware, electronics, boutiques, bookshops and more.

Frequently asked questions

What is Dukani?

Dukani is an online POS (point of sale) and stock management system made for businesses in Tanzania. You use it to record sales, manage stock, track expenses and see your profit — from a phone, tablet or computer.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. Every new business gets a 14-day free trial with all features. No payment is needed to start.

Does Dukani work for pharmacies and butcheries?

Yes. Pharmacies get batch and expiry tracking, prescriptions and a controlled drugs register. Butcheries can sell by weight in kilograms, run a daily price board and cut carcasses into stock.

Can I use Dukani on my phone?

Yes. Dukani runs in the browser on any Android phone, iPhone, tablet or computer, and can be installed like an app.

Dukani ni nini?

Dukani ni mfumo wa POS na usimamizi wa stoo kwa biashara za Tanzania. Unarekodi mauzo, unasimamia stoo, unafuatilia matumizi na kuona faida yako — kwa simu, tablet au kompyuta.

Je, kuna kipindi cha majaribio bure?

Ndiyo. Kila biashara mpya inapata siku 14 za majaribio bure, bila malipo yoyote kuanza.
